title: Extended Summer Studio Hours
content: To accommodate our busy local craftsmen and visitors, our workshop doors will remain open until 8:00 PM every Thursday through Saturday this month. Stop by for evening demonstrations!

title: New Batch of Walnut Boards Arrived
content: We just unloaded a stunning haul of local sustainably-sourced walnut lumber. Our team is already flattening and prepping them for custom dining table and cutting board commissions.
